title: 5.3.1. Paccuppannavāra
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Yo dukkhasaccaṁ parijānāti so samudayasaccaṁ pajahatīti? Āmantā.
Yo vā pana samudayasaccaṁ pajahati so dukkhasaccaṁ parijānātīti? Āmantā.
Yo dukkhasaccaṁ na parijānāti so samudayasaccaṁ nappajahatīti? Āmantā.
